skills.name: start_model_processing
skills.description: Run text processing independently while voice conversation continues. Use fast for light summaries or extraction, background for substantial analysis, reasoning for difficult planning and reasoning. Returns a job ID immediately; completion is announced later. These models cannot execute actions or verify current facts. Do not delegate greetings or simple conversation.

skills.name: model_processing_status
skills.description: Read a text-processing job result or progress using its job ID.
